rule: Scope, claims and release decisions are fail-closed. Evidence may narrow the supported profile but may never be generalized beyond the named profile.

declaredEvidenceProfile.claimBoundary: This is the only P0 supported evidence profile. It is not a cross-browser, Windows, macOS, weak-device or mobile support claim.

unsupportedClasses.statement: Native .node addons, node-gyp and arbitrary host-native binaries are unsupported in Core 1.x.
Arbitrary raw TCP/UDP/TLS socket semantics are unsupported in Core 1.x.
Full Linux/POSIX process, device and host-filesystem semantics are unsupported in Core 1.x.
Browser/OS/device profiles without retained evidence are unsupported and must not be marketed as supported.

outOfCore.rule: AI/LLM/agent behavior is a separately versioned consumer or adapter.
Git hosting integrations are consumers/adapters, not Core authority.

nonGoals: cloud VM orchestration, Kubernetes or Docker replacement
full Linux desktop or mandatory CPU emulation
P2P/distributed RAM, distributed inference or CUDA scheduling
model hosting or built-in coding-agent behavior
accounts, billing, team SaaS or a VS Code clone

releaseBlockers.definition: Confirmed loss or unrecoverable corruption of canonical user data.
Guest code escapes a declared capability/origin/authority boundary.
Secret material is disclosed through runtime, diagnostics, support or adapter paths.
Runtime reports success while producing materially incorrect canonical state or execution semantics.

severity.criticalRule: Any unresolved release blocker forces KILL or REDESIGN; it cannot be waived silently.

oneZeroCriteria: production_closed must be true in the gate ledger
all critical production gates must meet their frozen minimum closure
release verification and zero unexplained critical flake evidence must be current for the release commit
legal/FTO decisions required by P16 must be recorded
operations/vulnerability-response handoff required by P17 must be exercised
1.0 criteria are independent from future SaaS/Program B
